2607.09805.title: A Unified Model for Highly Accurate ECG-Free Dynamic Coronary Roadmapping Using Spatio-Temporal Transformers
2607.09805.paper_summary: Percutaneous Coronary Intervention (PCI) is a minimally invasive procedure used to restore coronary blood flow obstructed by atherosclerotic plaque. During PCI, repeated injections of iodine-based contrast agents are required to visualize the coronary arteries and guide interventional devices. However, frequent contrast injections increase radiation exposure and the risk of contrast-induced nephropathy, with acute kidney injury reported in up to 30% of patients with renal impairment. Dynamic Coronary Roadmapping (DRM) reduces these risks by overlaying a precomputed angiographic vessel map onto live fluoroscopy and continuously updating it throughout the procedure. Accurate DRM relies on precise cardiac phase matching between angiography and fluoroscopy, together with reliable catheter tip tracking for motion compensation. These tasks remain challenging in ECG-free settings and when only limited manual annotations are available. We present a unified DRM framework that simultaneously performs cardiac phase matching and catheter tip tracking for accurate real-time guidance. Our method employs a large-scale spatio-temporal encoder pretrained on 16 million X-ray frames to learn cardiac motion dynamics. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first application of large-scale spatio-temporal pretraining for motion compensation in DRM. We further introduce auxiliary tasks based on ECG R-peak detection and catheter tip tracking, improving optimization while eliminating the need for extensive catheter mask annotations. Finally, a majority-voting postprocessing strategy aggregates temporal predictions, improving robustness and providing a confidence score that correlates with phase-matching error. Comprehensive evaluation on clinical X-ray datasets demonstrates state-of-the-art performance, achieving low temporal misalignment and robust phase-matching accuracy suitable for real-time DRM.
2607.09805.paper_summary_zh: 經皮冠狀動脈介入治療（PCI）是一種微創手術，用於恢復因動脈粥樣硬化斑塊而阻塞的冠狀血流。<lb/>在PCI過程中，需要反覆注射碘基造影劑以可視化冠狀動脈並指導介入設備。<lb/>然而，頻繁的造影劑注射會增加輻射暴露和造影劑引起的腎病風險，報告顯示高達30%的腎功能不全患者會出現急性腎損傷。<lb/>動態冠狀動脈路徑規劃（DRM）通過將預先計算的血管造影圖疊加到實時透視影像上並在整個過程中持續更新，來降低這些風險。<lb/>準確的DRM依賴於血管造影和透視影像之間的精確心臟相位匹配，以及可靠的導管尖端追蹤以進行運動補償。<lb/>在無心電圖（ECG）環境下以及僅有有限手動註釋可用的情況下，這些任務仍然具有挑戰性。<lb/>我們提出了一個統一的DRM框架，同時執行心臟相位匹配和導管尖端追蹤，以實現準確的實時指導。<lb/>我們的方法使用了一個在1600萬幀X光影像上預訓練的大規模時空編碼器來學習心臟運動動力學。<lb/>據我們所知，這是大規模時空預訓練首次應用於DRM中的運動補償。<lb/>我們進一步引入基於ECG R波峰檢測和導管尖端追蹤的輔助任務，改善優化，同時消除對廣泛導管遮罩註釋的需求。<lb/>最後，多數投票後處理策略匯總時間預測，增強穩健性並提供與相位匹配誤差相關的信心分數。<lb/>在臨床X光數據集上的全面評估顯示出最先進的性能，實現了低時間錯位和適合實時DRM的穩健相位匹配準確性。
